messages.subject: awkward world cup one-liner
parts:
I have a tidy-ish dataframe in which rows correspond to events within football matches. Columns include 'team' and 'matchid':

  matchid team event player period time
      232  CHI     1  24667      1    1
      232  CHI     5   3651      1    1
      232  CHI     3  77102      1    4

I'd like to derive the number of games played by each team, by counting the number of unique matchid's for each team in this df.

Here is my really icky-feeling one-liner -- does anyone instantly see a simpler plyr/dplyr method I could learn from?? Or is kind of operation actually complicated?

GP =aggregate(freq ~ team, data=count(count(df,c('team','matchid'))[,c('team','matchid')],c('team','matchid')), sum)$freq

This monstrosity counts the matchid's for each team, resulting in a df with team, matchid and freq as columns
Discards freq and then counts them again, returning a df in which the 'freq' for each matchid is now 1
Then aggregates freq ~ team, using sum to get the total games played

Thank you for any advice.
